request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red smock becomes a ragged near-black charcoal smock with a thin bright violet trim along its torn hem; his skin becomes pallid light warm ash grey with no blue at all; the four blue flames and his eyes become bright glowing violet; the green moss on his shoulders becomes pale ivory bone spurs. Keep the stitches, iron plates, manacles, chains, belt, face,pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
